title: Cyberpunk Karate Fighter
description: A young man with silver and black hair, intricate circuit-like patterns shaved into the side of his head, stands in a fighting stance wearing a torn and patched blue and red karate gi. He wears orange and purple MMA gloves, multiple necklaces with a cross pendant, and patches on his shoulders reading 'PAY 01' and 'FINAL'.
prompt: A confident young man with silver and black hair and glowing blue eyes, intricate golden circuit patterns shaved into his fade haircut, smirking at the viewer. He wears a torn blue and red karate gi with patches that say PAY 01 and FINAL, orange and purple MMA gloves, and layered necklaces with a cross pendant. Dramatic cosmic background with purple and orange nebulae, glowing rings and stars, dynamic lighting, digital painting style
